package.name: hyper_interface
package.description: Serial bridge between ROS 2 and the Arduino board that drives the motor drivers. Subscribes to the same /velocity and /steering_angle command topics hyper_control's vehicle_controller uses in sim, and forwards them to the Arduino over USB serial using a small binary protocol. Drive (wheel encoder) and steering (position sensor) feedback both run closed loop on the Arduino (see arduino/) and are republished to ROS 2 as /velocity_actual, /steering_angle_actual, and /odom.
